## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 and 11 | `PsyAudio-Setup-{version}.exe` |
| Linux, any distribution | `PsyAudio-{version}-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint | `psyaudio_{version}_amd64.deb` |
| Fedora, openSUSE | `psyaudio-{version}-1.x86_64.rpm` |
| macOS, Apple Silicon and Intel | `PsyAudio-{version}-macOS.dmg` |

The macOS app is signed and notarized by Apple.
